child.label: Dating Rules of Thumb
child.description: Questions about how many people would agree with a general rule of thumb about dating, flirting, or attraction, rated from "practically no one" to "practically everyone".
child.not_for: Questions about what the answerer personally prefers, would do, or has done when dating (use Dating Choices & Preferences).
examples: How many people would agree: "It is rude to cancel a date at the last minute"?
How many people would agree: "It is okay to date a coworker"?
